kind: Direct implementation/proof review and isolated source replay; not an independent second-agent audit.
entry: with_triton_signature callSignature in triton { pasted Python body }

source_correspondence.verbatim_body: Python and Lean bodies are text-equal after dedenting, and AST-equal. No in-body metadata, antiquotes or added store cast.
source_correspondence.casts: Both explicit to(tl.int64) calls are retained.
source_correspondence.signature: Named pointer storage types, scalar carrier/precision and constexpr names are configured outside the body; these are not inferred from arbitrary Python text.
source_correspondence.call_binding: source invokes body through the generic withScalarArguments adapter. FP32 inv_127 is a bound runtime register; the unused n_elements integer is retained. integer describes the mathematical register channel, not an unannotated native ABI width.
source_correspondence.implicit_store: The shared frontend inserts destination conversion using the call signature and rejects unresolved destinations instead of dropping the cast.

real.target: scale * (signed weight : Real) / 127 for all active row outputs.
real.scope: Complete new callee and argument binding; successful execution, actual access safety, independent active output formula and all exterior raw cells. Original zero/negative scale, masked/empty row, unmasked scale and regional alias scopes retained.
real.projection: Existing local floating precision erasure and mathematical index model. NativeIndex.lane_exact separately retains the fixed-width physical address projection under the existing input bounds.

fp.target: Actual original and index-commuted complete new calls; all typed memory agrees and both executions succeed.
fp.transformation: Signed integer block_start multiplication commutativity, in full source context.
fp.scope: The existing ProfiledMemory program-pair judgment is preserved. It does not add hardware/ABI/compiler refinement or a numerical experiment.

io_organization: IO.lean retains the single regional/logical input/output interface and exact masks/windows. Source-level typing is a CallSignature outside the pasted body; call arguments are explicit data and use one shared adapter. No alternate runner or assumed successful execution is supplied.

validation.lean_regressions: Implicit masked FP16 store, signed INT8 input, actual runtime argument values, missing/duplicate metadata, forbidden in-body metadata, escaping aliases and unresolved store destinations.
validation.development_scope: Selected Contract/Correct/FPEquiv, source bridge, optional Tensor endpoint, both frontend regression files, and both argmax public entries after shared helper changes.
validation.clean_method: Began with no project artifacts or .veritile-cache, reusing pinned external Lean/Mathlib packages. Initial build passed; final fail-closed store guard was then checked out from Git and rebuilt in the same isolated directory. No project build artifacts were copied.
validation.axioms: Public Real/FP results and required execution/memory/safety bridges pass standard-base axiom checks.
validation.official_comparator: Both --trust calls fail preflight because the official comparator is unavailable; not passed.
validation.python_contract_runtime_check: Not run: torch is unavailable in the system Python. Python implementation/wrapper source is unchanged; AST correspondence and Lean contract/source proofs are checked.
validation.gpu: not run; no new numerical rewrite

remaining_limits: This first example validates a straight-line body. Existing DSL operation/control-flow spelling limits still apply; arbitrary Python bodies are not all supported.
Call signatures must be statically known and unsupported pointer/store forms fail closed.
Existing numerical primitive and mathematical-index model boundaries remain; no compiler/ISA/host refinement is claimed.
Official comparator and Torch runtime contract check unavailable.

corpus_followup.note: Argmax retains its earlier normalized AST/source proof certification; only dequantize_rowwise has been migrated to this pasted-body interface. Other tasks are not silently repaired or recertified.
